en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a corner view of a large brick building with a tiled roof and dormer windows, partly obscured by trees along the street. There are shopfronts at street level, a small car parked on the right, and a lamppost in the foreground. White printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Trollhättan and the building as Folkets Hus, and credit the photographer Ragnvald Hörne with an address in Trollhättan.
